period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. STANDALONE/SOLO basis used per project convention (matches this bank's primary Q4/annual series); the filing presents both a Condensed CONSOLIDATED statement set (pp.2-6) and a full Condensed [Solo/Standalone] statement set (pp.7-11), as usual for this bank. Income-statement line items are the 'Cumulative Jan to June 2018' column (the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended April to June 2018' column, not recorded here as line items per the Q2 cumulative-suffix convention). Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly in raw Taka: 276,530,827,637 (total liabilities) + 28,667,172,460 (total equity) = 305,198,000,097 (total assets). Reported equity sub-components sum exactly to total shareholders' equity in raw Taka; independent BDT-million rounding of each line can shift the displayed sub-component sum by ±1 BDT million versus the displayed total (immaterial, not a data error). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly in raw Taka; small ±1 BDT-million gaps between displayed cumulative subtotals are the same independent-rounding artifact, not a source discrepancy. NAV/CRAR/ROA/ROE/AD-ratio sourced from Note 6 'Performance Highlights' (Standalone basis, 30 June 2018); ROA/ROE explicitly labelled 'annualized' by the bank. Parallel Consolidated-basis comparators (not used, given for reference): total assets 342,366m, total equity incl. NCI 35,972m, NAV/share 29.03, EPS_cumulative 2.36, CRAR 14.53%, ROA* 1.53%, ROE* 17.56%.

source.source_page_lines: Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited) as at 30 June 2018 — Standalone basis (p.7); off-balance-sheet items / NAV per share continuation (p.8); Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited) for the half year ended 30 June 2018 — Standalone basis, Cumulative Jan-June 2018 column (p.9); Note 6 'Performance Highlights' Key Financial Indicators/Ratios (Standalone/Solo basis) (p.13). Parallel Condensed CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet/P&L also present on pp.2-4 (not used, per project convention of preferring Solo/Standalone when both are present in the filing).
